## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `b74f7ff4c739f74e04370f8e7f1d2c3ab3de0a79`
Local-runs: none

PR #37542, card #37520 (follow-up of the contract record 7189499173 on PR #37474). Read: the card's body and its three comments (triage 7190492158, claim 7190642371, os-dev report 7191993931), the final-head comment 7192432076 on the PR, the PR body, the net diff against `main` (7 files, +377/−4), and the record on #37474 that the card cites. Nothing was built, run or ablated. I judged the nine ablations by reading each pin against its mutation.

Check-runs on the head: 51 in total, 38 success and 13 skipped, with none failed or pending. Test UI 1–16, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards and Governed Surface Queue Guard all passed.

Findings, graded:

- S1 (should-fix): the `|| !!actions` arm of the N3 guard has no pin. Each new N3 case has either no actions, or actions together with Save, and Save brings the hairline on its own. So `rowHasOwnControls = (stats?.length ?? 0) > 0` would keep every suite green. One real caller depends on this arm: `ResourceEditPage`'s embedded frame passes `actions` with no `stats` and does not pass `embedded` to `PageShell`, so its row end draws. The fix is one case: actions with no stats and nothing unsaved, expecting the hairline before the assistant.
- N1 (nit): `!!actions` tests whether the ReactNode is truthy. A fragment that is always passed but renders nothing still counts as a control and draws the hairline. No current caller reaches this, because every caller that passes such a fragment also passes `stats`.
- N2 (nit): in the N4 pin, the variant-match half holds for any node under `html.dark`. The behaviour the pin actually holds is the binding in `styles.css`, plus the dark declarations on the surface root and on `body`, checked against `STUDIO_ACCENT_HSL.dark`. Those parts are not tautological: A9 turns the case red.

### ① Derived judgments

**The card's items against the diff.**

- S1, the slot toggle with no copilot: pinned, with a control. The case checks that the toggle is the only one on the page, is absent from the top bar and from the slot, and is the last control in its row behind the hairline. It also checks that clicking it hides and shows the slot, and that `aria-pressed` and the accessible name follow. If the toggle arm returns null (A1), `findByTestId` fails. The control serves a copilot and expects the assistant with no toggle. `copilot.available` is reset in `beforeEach`.
- S2, the four unpinned row ends that the #37474 record named: each is now pinned.
  - PageShell's compact row: the right-aligned group's order is pinned (actions, Save, hairline, assistant). A2 turns 4 cases red.
  - The `!embedded` gate on both rows: an embedded case gives Save and expects neither Save nor the assistant. Dropping either gate (A3, A4) renders Save, so each case goes red.
  - The directory header: the exact list of testids is pinned, which also holds `divider={false}`. There is an outside-Studio control.
  - The diagnostics header: the row end is the row's last child and comes after Refresh. There is an outside-Studio control.
- N1, the accent counter: two mounted, one unmounted, then the last unmounted. Deleting the `mountedSurfaces > 0` early return (A8) strips `body` at the first unmount, so the case goes red. The one-mount control holds.
- N4, the dark scope: pinned within what jsdom can read (see N2). The happy-dom `:where()` workaround is declared, and the light control rules out a vacuous pass.
- N3, the divider guard in `PageShell.tsx`: correct for every caller. Each caller as the diff leaves it:
  - Outside the Studio surface, `StudioTitleRowEnd` returns null, so Setup and every bare mount are unchanged.
  - With `embedded`, no row end is drawn, so the guard does not apply.
  - `ResourceListPage` (list row), `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s main return (compact row) and `ResourceHistoryPage` (compact row, in `item-tools`, outside metadata-admin) always pass `stats`. The hairline stays as before.
  - `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s loading and draft-refused shells pass no stats and no actions, so they now draw no lone hairline. This is the fix.
  - `ResourceEditPage`'s embedded frame passes actions with no stats, so the hairline is kept. The behaviour is right, but the arm is unpinned (S1 above).
  - Save still brings the hairline through `StudioTitleRowEnd`'s `divider || save`.
  - `DeviceAuthPage`'s `PageShell` is an unrelated local component.
- The nine ablations each turn red as claimed. The guard's actions arm is the only part with no ablation (S1 above).

**File surface.** The diff stays within the claim's surface: tests under `studio-design/**` and `metadata-admin/**`, the N3 hunk in `PageShell.tsx`, and one changeset. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `studioMenuModel.ts` and `StudioPackageMenu.tsx` are not in the diff. The A1 mutation was on disk only.

**Public surface.** None changes. `PageShell`'s props are unchanged. Its barrel export `MetadataPageShell` has no consumer outside app-shell, and `@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true`.

**Main drift.** The branch was not re-merged after `main` moved. The only change on `main` since the merge base in these view directories is a one-line deletion in `ResourceListPage.tsx`, outside its `PageShell` call.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` is right. The diff changes rendered output in one private UI package and publishes nothing else. Check Changeset passed.
- `Clause-②: no` is right, with no arm. The diff widens or narrows no published accept set, and no schema, metadata key or export moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right too, and both lines appear in the changeset body and in the PR body.
- The changeset text matches the diff: the hairline is drawn when the row has stats, actions or Save, and nothing changes outside Studio.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. `open_questions`: empty.
2. Out-of-scope note (happy-dom does not match a descendant combinator inside `:where()`): accepted as noted and not filed. It concerns the test DOM only, the pin works around it in the open, and the light control keeps the pin honest.
3. Deviations:
   - The commit trailers and PR footer follow AGENTS.md: accepted.
   - The branch was not re-merged: accepted, because the drift touches none of these lines (see ①).
   - The full app-shell suite was left to CI: accepted, because Test UI 1–16 is green on this head.
4. SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff has no query, no id materialisation and no join.

This is a delta review on PR #37542. The prior record is 7192526450, at head `b74f7ff4`, and the seat's REWORK is 7192537138. I read three things: `git diff b74f7ff4..fb89b42a`, the net diff against `main`, and the check-runs on the new head. Nothing was built, run or ablated.

The delta is two commits:
- `014d83c4cc`, a merge of `origin/main`.
- `fb89b42aad`, one test commit: +17 in `PageShell.narrowHeader-12306.test.tsx`.

**The merge changed none of the PR's own lines.** For each of the PR's 7 files, the diff from `b74f7ff4` to the merge commit is empty. The net diff against `main` matches the prior head's net diff line for line. The only difference is the 17 added test lines (7 files, +394/−4).

Check-runs on the head: 51 in total, 38 success and 13 skipped, with none failed or pending. Among the successes are Test UI, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI and Check Changeset.

Prior findings, by id:

- **S1 (should-fix): closed.** The new `it.each` covers the compact row and the list row. Each case has actions, no stats and nothing unsaved. It asserts three things:
  - Save is absent.
  - The hairline sits directly before the assistant.
  - The group's testids are exactly `page-action`, `studio-title-row-divider`, `topbar-ai-assistant`.

  With `rowHasOwnControls = (stats?.length ?? 0) > 0`, neither row would draw the divider, so both cases would go red. This agrees with the area's claim that 2 cases go red. With Save null, nothing else can bring the hairline, so the cases are not tautological.
- **N1 (nit): stays open as an accepted deviation (REWORK 7192537138).** A fragment that always renders but holds nothing still counts as the row's own control. No caller reaches this case today.
- **N2 (nit): stays open as an accepted deviation (REWORK 7192537138).** The variant-match half of the dark pin passes for any node under `html.dark`. The declaration half is the part that holds the behaviour.

No new findings.

### ① Derived judgments

Nothing changes from 7192526450. The delta adds a test and no product line. `PageShell.tsx` is identical to the prior head, and the divider guard's judgment for every caller stands. No public surface changes.

### ② Semver level

Nothing changes from 7192526450. The changeset is unchanged: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` remain right, because a test-only delta publishes nothing.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. No new dev flags or `open_questions`. The REWORK owed one case, and the delta adds it.
2. The merge was checked as stated above: it touches none of the PR's lines.
3. SQL push-down: not applicable. The delta has no query, no id materialisation and no join.
